dynamic_fee_applied.meaning: the dynamically calculated fee is applied by the dynamic fee mechanism rather than falling back to basic tick spacing fees

fee_caps_conflict.meaning: the fee caps of DynamicSwapFeeModule.getFee() and CLFactory.getSwapFee() conflict such that the dynamic fee mechanism is rendered ineffective

assumptions: The dynamic fee mechanism is expected to apply dynamically calculated fees rather than always falling back to basic tick spacing fees.

unresolved.description: Report does not state the concrete numeric fee values or the exact cap used by CLFactory.getSwapFee(), so the conflicting-cap relation cannot be expressed as a numeric comparison; it is represented as a grounded Boolean outcome.
Report does not specify the concrete dynamic fee value above 10% or the exact fallback fee, so the ineffective-mechanism outcome is encoded qualitatively.

limitations: The correspondence pattern uses the same observable for observed and expected because the report does not supply a distinct expected reference quantity; the Boolean dynamic_fee_applied captures the qualitative desired outcome.
The conflicting fee caps are represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison because the report omits the CLFactory cap value.
